findings.summary: Choosing Other amount creates an unnamed donation amount input and removes the existing label target.
findings.fix: Give the new input id=id_amount so the existing Donation amount label remains associated; associate the USD integer instruction using aria-describedby.
findings.evidence: Production /fundraising/: Other amount creates <input type="number" name="amount"> with labels=[], aria-label=null, aria-labelledby=null; axe label failure. See evidence/behavior.json.

findings.summary: Donation management renders amount, interval and logo fields without associated labels.
findings.fix: Render each normal field with as_field_group or label_tag; use fieldsets and legends for radio groups and associate help/error descriptions.
findings.evidence: The normal-field branch renders only {{ field }}. DonationForm subscription_amount and interval have no placeholder; DjangoHeroForm logo has no label.

findings.summary: Corporate membership file and membership-level controls have plain text labels without programmatic association.
findings.fix: Use field.label_tag or field.as_field_group for all controls, keeping visible labels for text fields as well.
findings.evidence: Production corporate join: id_logo and id_membership_level have labels=[]; membership select fails axe select-name. Plain {{ field.label }} is not linked to either control.

findings.summary: The contact form does not expose autocomplete purposes for the user name and email.
findings.fix: Set autocomplete=name on name and autocomplete=email on email; add appropriate name/email tokens to profile and corporate contact fields.
findings.evidence: BaseContactForm name/email widgets specify only class=required; accounts/forms.py:31-35 similarly sets only placeholder.

findings.summary: Successful payment-card updates are inserted without an assistive-technology status announcement.
findings.fix: Give .change-card-result role=status before updates, keeping the visible Card updated text.
findings.evidence: The callback sets .change-card-result.text("Card updated"); manage-donations.html:48 renders a plain span without role or aria-live.

passed: Registration and login templates provide explicitly associated visible username/password/email labels.
Documentation search input has a visually hidden associated label and named submit button.
Foundation contact form uses Django as_field_group rendering.
Donation frequency and preset amount selects have associated visible labels.
notes: No forms submitted, accounts modified, payments made, or third-party checkout opened.

Custom paragraph errors/help text in older templates do not supply IDs even though modern Django may auto-generate aria-describedby references; verify rendered invalid forms locally before recording an additional failure.

Profile and several corporate/donor text fields rely on placeholders; persistent labels are recommended, but placeholder presence alone is not recorded as an unequivocal missing accessible-name failure.
Source defects in authenticated donation-management/profile views are recorded as source-only coverage, not verified production behavior.
